semantic_findings.finding: One appended VotersRecord becomes active immediately; the new set majority must commit its exclusive end.
Known current-epoch HW and strictly committed prior VotersRecord are required; pending or uncommitted changes block another.
Bare LeaderState catch-up uses observed timestamps and a strict one-hour fetch horizon, permits reported end regression; owner correlation and durable prefix validation are additional checks.
VoterSetHistory logs but accepts disjoint configurations. Helper acceptance does not prove a safe transition.
Common commit ACK is supported across all3. Newer early ACK completes before commit while retaining pending state; the local common profile explicitly excludes it.

Normal leader-removal resigns after new-majority commit; if its RPC state expires first, bare component late commit does not request resign. Local committed-membership fencing must remain independent of an expired request. KafkaRaftClient poll source is retained but no full poll/network runtime is claimed.
Native epoch5 maps to normalized local term6; VotersRecord nativeoffsetN-1 maps to one-based inclusive indexN/nativeexclusiveendN.
Actual local Apache log replay retains voter control records but resets its component HW to0; no durable replicated commit or application snapshot safety inference.
